RESULT [continual]: At 405M parameters on a weak shift with 5% replay, average loss is 2.37 continual vs 2.35 union-trained, and evaluation average is 35.14% vs 34.30%. At 10B, loss is 1.89 vs 1.87. Every re-warm raises loss even with no distribution shift. For the strong shift, 25% replay cut forgetting by 1.23 nats of final loss.
US [continual]: It says two things about how the increment is trained. First, replay a fixed share of the accepted base pool in every increment rather than training on the new slice alone. Second, let the LR schedule finish its decay. The repo's rounds did neither: optimizer=auto silently turned lr0=0.001 into 0.01, peaked near 0.03, and patience=20 cut the cosine off at 21-35 of about 50 epochs.
